body:
WHAT
Session.saveMeta() is the one writer of the transcript's meta record (stats snapshot, model, overdrive, label — the fields resume reads through Transcript.latestMeta / SessionStats.fromSnapshot). It runs, as before, at every turn end (forced), and now also right after each model call is banked (recordResponse), at most once per 30 s (META_SAVE_EVERY_MS). Root sessions only — children share the root's ledger. The engine's rename and auto-name paths still merge over the latest meta, so a label written between saves is kept.

WHY
Field test 2026-09-23, finding E-06: the meta record was appended only in the turn's finally block, so a crash during a long turn (the field turn ran 56 minutes) lost that whole turn's token data.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — saveMeta(), META_SAVE_EVERY_MS, the call after recordResponse in streamAssistantTurn, the forced call at turn end.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (fs) A real engine turn whose first model call (usage 1,234 output tokens) asks for a deletion is held on that permission card; while it waits, the transcript on disk already holds a meta record whose stats count those 1,234 output tokens. Answered, the turn ends and the last meta counts both calls.
